title: Home Minister Receives ₹22.90 Crore Dividend from REPCO Bank for FY26
summary: State-backed cooperative bank returns 30% dividend on government equity.

blocks.content: State-backed cooperative bank returns 30% dividend on government equity.

items: Shareholding: Govt of India holds 76.32% share capital (₹76.32 crore).

blocks.title: Static Background & GK Context
blocks.summary: REPCO Bank established Nov 19, 1969 under Madras Cooperative Societies Act 1961 (Chairman: E. Santhanam; MHA control; operates in TN, AP, KL, KA).
